newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health unit starts tender.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health unit starts tender.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc said on Monday that its Foundation Health Corp subsidiary has begun a cash tender offer for any and all of the $125 million outstanding principal amount of its 7-3/4 percent Senior Notes due 2003.

The purchase price to be paid for each tendered note will be based on a fixed spread of 25 basis points over the yield of the 6-1/4 percent U.S. Treasury Notes due February 15, 2003 as of 1400 EDT (1800 GMT) June 25, plus accrued and unpaid interest to the applicable settlement date.

Consummation of the tender offer is subject to the condition that at least $62,500,000 in aggregate principal amount of notes are validly tendered and not withdrawn as of 1700 EDT (2100 GMT) on June 26.

By 1300 EDT (1700 GMT) on June 27, Foundation will publicly announce whether such condition has been satisfied. If such condition is not satisfied, the company said it reserves the right to terminate the offer.
